errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the F1 line decreases to its final point at x=8. The chart shows the line decreases from x=5 to a local minimum at x=7 (approx. 74.9%), and then rises to x=8 (approx. 75.7%). The description misrepresents the direction of the trend between the last two data points.
The description states the accuracy (Acc) at x=5 is approximately 75.5%. However, the data point on the chart is visibly very close to the 76% line, at approximately 75.9%.

The description of the Acc line's trend from x=5 to x=8 is incomplete. It completely omits the most prominent feature of this line: the steep drop to a global minimum at x=7 (approx. 70%) before rising again to the value at x=8.
